title: Man City in League Two · Part 3

beats.kicker: Man City in League Two · Part 3
beats.headline: City: [90 minutes] from the Championship.
beats.vo: Man City were ninety minutes from the Championship.

beats.headline: Twelfth, and [leaking goals].
beats.vo: Season two: League One. Twelfth at halfway, and leaking goals. So you voted… and half of you picked Kelland Watts.

beats.headline: Watts: [the fans' pick].
beats.vo: A centre-back from Cambridge. Fifteen starts in League One, two goals.

beats.headline: His second game: [0–4].
beats.vo: His second game: Leicester win four–nil. Welcome to League One.

beats.headline: Five wins. [Fifth].
beats.vo: Then five wins in a row. Wycombe, Doncaster, Stevenage, Huddersfield, Notts County. City climb to fifth.

beats.headline: Haaland twice: [top three].

card.sub: for the first time in League One

beats.vo: Grimsby come to City. Haaland scores twice. Top three for the first time.

beats.headline: Stockport win [4–3].
beats.vo: Stockport win a seven-goal thriller, four–three. Remember them.

beats.headline: The champions: [Oxford 4–2].
beats.vo: Oxford, the champions, win four–two. Haaland still ends on twenty-nine.

beats.headline: Last day: [level with second].
beats.vo: But here's where it hurts. The last day: level on points with second… against Cambridge. Watts's old club.

beats.headline: 1–1. City [finish fourth].
beats.vo: One–one. Wednesday win. City finish fourth.

beats.headline: Stockport again: [4–0].
beats.vo: Play-offs. Stockport again. Four–nil over two legs.

beats.headline: Bradford: [the best defence].
beats.vo: Then Wembley. Bradford City, the best defence in the league.

beats.headline: Bradford 2–0. [City stay down].
beats.vo: Bradford win two–nil. City stay in League One.

beats.headline: 93 goals. [Not enough].

card.label: league goals · the most in League One

beats.vo: Ninety-three goals, the most in the league. Not enough. Who should City sign this summer?
